Callout.Name: Stolen Motorcycle
Callout.Message: Motorcycle taken from outside a cafe minutes ago.
Callout.Advisory: Two riders, both in dark clothing, no plates.

Script.Line: It was outside the cafe and I went in for a coffee.
Two minutes. Two minutes and it was gone.
It is black with a red tank. That is all I can tell you.

Lines.Approach: Two on it, no plates, gone towards the freeway. They will not stop for you.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
